scripts.check:no-deno: if grep -rqE 'deno\.land|Deno\.' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=specs .; then echo 'Deno references remain'; exit 1; fi
scripts.check:relay-pure: if grep -rqE "from ['\"].*crypto/" src/server/; then echo 'relay imports crypto'; exit 1; fi
scripts.check:readme: grep -A 20 'does not protect you against' README.md | grep -q 'forward secrecy'
